name: Biostatistics PhD
detailsNote: Fall 2027 application confirmed. BGS common policies supplemented with degree-specific requirements; admission model omitted where not established.

applicationFee.note: No fee to apply to BGS; no waiver needed.

english.note: BGS accepts TOEFL/IELTS/DET without numerical minimum. US or approved English-instructed degree exempts after review; no separate waiver request needed. Official reports by deadline; expired TOEFL requires retake. International intake highly competitive and limited.

documents: Unofficial transcripts from all institutions plus translations
requirements.note: Prior one year calculus including multivariable, semester linear algebra, course statistics and working programming-language knowledge. Data-analysis experience desirable; advanced maths strongly encouraged. Current 2027–28 programme page supports separate Biostatistics entry.

funding.note: Standard BGS PhD entrants receive tuition, fees, health insurance and stipend, generally 5–6 years. EffectiveFall 2026 stipend$49,000, not a Fall 2027 rate. Prior MD/VMD/DMD/PhD or other professional-degree holders must secure their own entire programme funding; international intake limited.
